Build trust and stay compliant
Lay the foundation for AI-Ready Governance with cross-functional alignment, automated controls, and global regulatory readiness.
Build a comprehensive AI inventory
Automate discovery and registration of AI models, datasets, vendors, and agents. Map relationships across systems to ensure traceability, reduce duplication, and maintain continuous visibility across your AI landscape.
Why this works:
Reinforces always-on visibility
Keeps feature-led clarity
Operationalize AI frameworks and standards
Operationalize AI risk management frameworks by mapping AI systems to evolving standards and regulatory requirements such as the EU AI Act, ISO 42001, and NIST RMF—supported by out-of-the-box assessments, risk and control libraries, embedded regulatory research, and role-based workflows designed to scale.
Evaluate risk early in the AI lifecycle
Proactively evaluate use cases for risk and context before development or deployment begins, leveraging pre-built integrations to gain visibility into models, datasets, and intended usage.
Govern continuously for greater ROI
Automate governance from ideation to deployment to align teams and ship faster.
Scale documentation and transparency
Automatically generate model cards, AI bills of materials (BoM), lineage reports, and dashboards to streamline audits, meet regulatory obligations, and build trust.
Automate AI discovery & asset management
Integrate with MLOps and data platforms to automatically discover and track agents, models, and datasets, ensuring alignment with governance policies and regulatory requirements from the outset.
Set governance checks across the AI lifecycle
Schedule evaluations at key development milestones and set alerts for data drift or model changes to keep governance proactive and timely.
Accelerate AI adoption through trust
Turn trust into results with automated governance, proactive risk mitigation, and transparent reporting.
Demonstrate responsible AI by design
Automatically enforce and monitor policies across the development and deployment lifecycle, reducing manual oversight, ensuring consistent, compliant AI standards, and demonstrating responsible AI by design through measurable accountability.
Empower user-centric control
Support data subject rights and privacy regulations by enabling user choices about their data and AI interactions, whether it’s consent preferences, opt-outs, or transparency into model decisions.
Proven results

FAQ
What is AI governance and why does it matter for enterprise organizations?
AI governance refers to the policies, processes, and tools that ensure AI systems are developed, deployed, and monitored responsibly. It helps enterprises innovate while managing risk, complying with regulations like the
EU AI Act
, and maintaining trust with customers and regulators.
OneTrust helps organizations embed governance by default across the AI lifecycle, enabling real-time control, continuous oversight, and responsible innovation at scale.
How can we comply with the EU AI Act and other global AI regulations?
Compliance requires classifying AI systems by risk level, performing impact assessments, maintaining documentation, and continuously monitoring AI use. OneTrust automate this with out-of-the-box assessments, regulatory updates, and policy enforcement to meet evolving requirements.
Learn more about
EU AI Act compliance
What should an enterprise AI governance framework include?
Key components include: AI use case intake and approval workflows, a unified asset inventory, lifecycle checkpoints, centralized policy enforcement, and real-time monitoring of risk and model performance.
OneTrust delivers all of these through a single platform, transforming governance from manual oversight into intelligent, scalable orchestration.
How can we reduce friction between compliance and innovation teams deploying AI initiatives?
Enterprises often face slowdowns due to manual checkpoints, siloed processes, and unclear ownership. Automating governance tasks and standardizing risk evaluations allow technical and compliance teams to collaborate more efficiently. OneTrust enables pre-cleared governance patterns, reusable workflows, and federated policy management so teams can move faster without sacrificing trust or compliance.
What tools help manage AI risk, reduce bias, and prove responsible AI practices?
AI governance platforms help identify and manage risk across the AI lifecycle by tracking performance, surfacing risk signals, and detecting potential sources of bias. They automate key documentation — like model cards, bills of materials, and lineage reports — and provide transparency into how AI systems are built, trained, and deployed. These capabilities are critical for supporting audits, addressing ethical concerns, and demonstrating responsible AI to stakeholders.
OneTrust enables organizations to monitor AI risk in real time, reduce model bias through continuous oversight, and generate audit-ready documentation.
